exchange-status.help: Check Futures Testnet connection: signature, clock skew, balance, position mode

args.name: --json
args.help: Print the result as JSON (schema sew.exchange-status/1) instead of the text report

args.name: --format
args.help: Output format: text (default), json, or any other registered format

preflight.help: Check this machine before the first order: clock skew, credentials, key permissions, outbound address, disk, data root, Python. Read-only; exit 0 none failed, 4 a check failed, 5 credentials absent or refused, 6 exchange unreachable

args.name: --venue
args.help: Check only this venue (default: every enabled venue)

args.name: --skip
args.help: Comma-separated check ids to skip, e.g. disk-space,python-floor

args.name: --json
args.help: Print the result as JSON (schema sew.preflight/1) instead of the text report

args.name: --format
args.help: Output format: text (default), json, or any other registered format

order-preview.help: Preview a normalized live order (rounding + minNotional check) without sending it

args.name: --type
args.help: Order type (a stop-limit needs a stop price, which this command does not take)

args.name: --price
args.help: Reference price for the notional estimate (decimal string) — required: this task has no live mark-price network path

args.name: --json
args.help: Print the normalized domain Order as JSON (schema sew.order-preview/1) instead of the text report

args.name: --format
args.help: Output format: text (default), json, or any other registered format

order-dry-run.help: Send a normalized order to POST /fapi/v1/order/test — validates signature, permissions and payload, creates nothing

args.name: --type
args.help: Order type (a stop-limit needs a stop price, which this command does not take)

args.name: --price
args.help: Reference price for the notional estimate (decimal string) — required: this task has no live mark-price network path

trade-once.help: Run one strategy evaluation and, if actionable, attempt one order through the full safety pipeline. DRY-RUN unless --live is passed. Not a daemon — runs one round and exits

args.name: --live
args.help: Actually submit the order (POST /fapi/v1/order). Without this flag, stops after showing the decision — no order-submission network call at all
